General elections are scheduled to be held in the [[Netherlands]] on 15 May 2030 to elect the members of the [[House of Representatives (Netherlands)|House of Representatives]], but may be held at an earlier date if a snap election is called.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.kiesraad.nl/verkiezingen/tweede-kamer |title=Tweede Kamerverkiezing |work=[[Electoral Council|Kiesraad]] |access-date=9 August 2026 |language=nl}}</ref>

==Background==
{{See also|2025–2026 Dutch cabinet formation}}

The [[2025 Dutch general election]] resulted in losses for all parties in the [[Schoof cabinet]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://nos.nl/collectie/14006/liveblog/2588440-d66-en-pvv-nek-aan-nek-verschil-minder-dan-2000-stemmen |title=D66 en PVV nek aan nek, verschil minder dan 2000 stemmen |work=[[Nederlandse Omroep Stichting|NOS]] |date=30 October 2025 |access-date=9 August 2026 |language=nl}}</ref> [[Democrats 66]] (D66) became the largest party in the House of Representatives for the first time, winning 26 seats, the same number as the [[Party for Freedom]] (PVV), but receiving 29,668 more votes.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://nltimes.nl/2025/11/07/official-election-results-confirm-26-seats-d66-pvv-change-final-exit-polls |title=Official election results confirm 26 seats for D66, PVV; No change from final exit polls |work=NL Times |date=7 November 2025 |access-date=9 August 2026 |language=en}}</ref> [[GroenLinks]] (GL) and the [[Labour Party (Netherlands)|Labour Party]] (PvdA) merged in 2026 to form [[Progressief Nederland]] (PRO).<ref>{{Cite news |url=https://www.trouw.nl/politiek/eindelijk-is-de-linkse-fusie-werkelijkheid-geworden-nu-al-die-andere-dromen-nog-dit-land-kan-zoveel-eerlijker~bc911969/ |title=Eindelijk is de linkse fusie werkelijkheid geworden, nu al die andere dromen nog: ‘Dit land kan zoveel eerlijker’ |trans-title=Finally, the left-wing merger has become a reality; now all those other dreams remain: “This country could be so much fairer” |work=[[Trouw]] |date=13 June 2026 |access-date=9 August 2026 |language=nl|author=Judith Harmsen}}</ref>

==Electoral system==
{{Main|Elections in the Netherlands}}

Eligible voters are Dutch nationals who are at least 18 years old on nomination day and have not been deprived of their right to vote following a [[criminal conviction]]. Electoral procedures are governed by the Dutch Electoral Act.<ref name="parlement">{{Cite web |url=https://www.parlement.com/tweede-kamerverkiezingen |title=Tweede Kamerverkiezingen |website=Parlement.com |publisher=Montesquieu Instituut |access-date=9 August 2026 |language=nl}}</ref>

Elections for the [[House of Representatives (Netherlands)|House of Representatives]] are normally held every four years, unless a [[snap election]] is called. Regular general elections in the Netherlands are held in March. However, due to municipal elections already taking place in March 2030, general elections would instead be held in May 2030.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://prodemos.nl/kennis/informatie-over-politiek/verkiezingen/verkiezingen-waarvoor/ |title=Verkiezingen waarvoor? |website=ProDemos |access-date=9 August 2026 |language=nl}}</ref><ref name="parlement" /><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.kiesraad.nl/vraag-en-antwoord/tweede-kamer-organiseren-verkiezing/tweede-kamer-hoe-wordt-de-datum-voor-reguliere-verkiezingen-bepaald |title=Tweede Kamer: hoe wordt de datum voor reguliere verkiezingen bepaald? |trans-title=House of Representatives: How is the date for regular elections determined? |work=[[Electoral Council|Kiesraad]] |access-date=9 August 2026 |language=nl}}</ref>

The 150 members of the House of Representatives are elected by [[semi-open list]] [[proportional representation]]. The number of seats per list is determined using the [[D'Hondt method]]. A list must receive a number of votes equal to or exceeding the [[Hare quota]] (1 full seat) in order to qualify for seat distribution, meaning there is an [[electoral threshold]] of 0.67%.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.kiesraad.nl/verkiezingen/tweede-kamer/uitslagen/zetelverdeling-over-partijen |title=Zetelverdeling over partijen |website=Kiesraad |date=22 April 2016 |language=nl |accessdate=9 July 2023 |archive-date=9 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230709100010/https://www.kiesraad.nl/verkiezingen/tweede-kamer/uitslagen/zetelverdeling-over-partijen |url-status=live }}</ref>

Voters have the option to cast a preferential vote. The seats won by a list are first allocated to the candidates who, in preferential votes, have received at least 25% of the Hare quota (effectively ¼ of a seat or 0.17% of the total votes), regardless of their placement on the electoral list. If multiple candidates from a list pass this threshold, their ordering is determined based on the number of votes received. Any remaining seats are allocated to candidates according to their position on the electoral list.<ref>{{cite report|title=Nederland, Parlementsverkiezingen, 15 maart 2017: Eindrapport|url=http://www.osce.org/nl/odihr/elections/netherlands/322761?download=true|publisher=OSCE/ODIHR|date=7 June 2017|access-date=28 October 2017|archive-date=24 October 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201024093005/http://www.osce.org/nl/odihr/elections/netherlands/322761?download=true|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.kiesraad.nl/verkiezingen/tweede-kamer/uitslagen/zetelverdeling-over-kandidaten |title=Zetelverdeling over kandidaten |website=Kiesraad |date=22 April 2016 |language=nl |accessdate=9 July 2023 |archive-date=9 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230709100008/https://www.kiesraad.nl/verkiezingen/tweede-kamer/uitslagen/zetelverdeling-over-kandidaten |url-status=live }}</ref>
